_source: topk-embed-v1-small on the final RC's wave (the engine image vllm/vllm-openai:v0.31.0): each image document row's FULL-WIDTH (mrl_dim null) minimum per-token cosine, read from the wave's equivalence.json (stage2.per_vector) -- the statistic the probe's E6 computes. The nine image document rows (20-28) are the calibration numbers the probe's E1/E6 compare against; the row-28 entry is its image document (document 1). _minima_over_all_widths holds each row's minimum over EVERY mrl width the wave measured; this file carried those values under the top-level keys until lane topkrun relabelled them, because its first _source called them 'mrl_dim null' and that was wrong (row 23's -0.35538 is the k=64 minimum, not the full-width -0.068241).
